policy: Accept only independently verified SSCE practice; historical acceptance of other apps, tax-source accuracy and deployment remain separate.

evidence.workflow: Coordinator independently passed five Node tests and four FR/SW browser cases on the candidate and integrated source. All 40 quick and 28 written activities preserve identities, answers, numerical meanings, English assessment language and cross-language backup compatibility. Mobile screenshots reviewed at 320/375px; keyboard, retries and private request boundaries checked. Independent content review correction incorporated.
evidence.export: Quick and written reports, downloads and cross-language backups exercised with synthetic responses, with parsed download checks. Malformed or unknown backups reject without mutating saved data. Written practice remains self-checking and does not claim automated grading.
